images.scope: Genuine same-camera 330x330 subfrustum, independently rendered at 1254; not an upscaled image.

technicalChecks: Both actual frames have no browser/resource/GL errors, linked shaders and valid pixels. This is not visual acceptance.
positiveObserved: The detached complete bright white torus rings are absent in the actual full frame and native detail.
The existing hall, layout, open bridge/stair route, stones and camera are retained.
Water response no longer has a white diffuse/emissive/alpha outline; it only perturbs the existing water coat and actual reflected scene.
failedOrUnresolved: The replacement water-wave response is too weak/sparse to read as the reference rain impacts in the full actual image.
The native detail does not establish convincing replacement ripple density or varied impact crests.
The reference water has much richer fragmented reflections and bright/dark local wave structure; this candidate does not reproduce that density or contrast.
No motion validation is included in the two-frame budget; temporal realism is unaccepted.
causeLimit: Strict water gating, sparse retained impacts and strong physical amplitude/footprint attenuation are plausible contributors to the weak result; their individual contributions were not isolated by an actual ablation.
